title: SkillSandbox: Skill Verification via Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
title_zh: SkillSandbox: Skill Verification via Dynamic Scenario Synthesis

paragraphs.en: Self-evolving agents distill task-solving experience into skills for future reuse, but these skills can encode incorrect procedures or non-transferable knowledge. It is therefore critical to verify each skill’s reusability : whether its guidance remains useful beyond the experience from which it was distilled. Such verification requires observing how a skill affects execution in new tasks, yet existing tasks may not expose the situations where the target skill can actually be exercised. To construct such situations, we propose SkillSandbox , a framework that dynamically synthesizes a task and its environment for each skill that are skill-relevant yet novel. A Proposer specifies the conditions to preserve and the source-specific details to vary, a Builder constructs an executable scenario, and a Verifier compares executions with and without the skill. The Verifier assesses executability, utility, and efficiency to assign a Keep or Reject verdict, determining whether the skill enters the library. Across ALFWorld and WebShop with three models, SkillSandbox consistently yields the strongest downstream performance and improved execution efficiency. Further analyses examine whether these gains reflect accurate assessment of skill reusability and identify which components of SkillSandbox contribute to them. [CODE]
paragraphs.zh: 自我演化的智能体将任务解决经验提炼为可供未来重用的技能，但这些技能可能编码了错误的流程或无法迁移的知识。 因此，验证每项技能的可重用性至关重要：即其指导作用在提炼时所依据的经验之外是否仍然有效。 此类验证需要观察某项技能在新任务中如何影响执行过程，但现有任务可能无法暴露目标技能真正能够发挥作用的情境。 为了构建这类情境，我们提出了 SkillSandbox——一个框架，能为每项技能动态合成与其相关且新颖的任务与环境。 提案器（Proposer）负责指定需保留的条件和需变化的源特定细节，构建器（Builder）则构造一个可执行的场景，验证器（Verifier）则比较使用与不使用该技能的执行结果。 验证器通过评估可执行性、实用性和效率来给出“保留”或“拒绝”的判定，从而决定该技能是否被纳入技能库。 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 数据集上，结合三种模型测试表明，SkillSandbox 始终能带来最强的下游任务表现和更高的执行效率。 进一步的分析探讨了这些提升是否反映了技能可重用性的准确评估，并识别了 SkillSandbox 中哪些组件对此做出了贡献。[CODE]

paragraphs.en: Self-evolving agents seek to improve their capabilities by learning from their own experiences ( Gao et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . They distill task-solving experience into skills ( Anthropic, 2025 ) that provide procedural guidance and store them in a library for future reuse ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Ouyang et al., 2026b ) . However, distilled skills do not always guarantee the performance improvement ( Li et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ; Gautam et al., 2026 ) . Because task-solving experience contains redundant exploration, mistakes, and task-specific details, distillation may yield incorrect procedures or non-transferable knowledge ( Ni et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Xiong et al., 2026 ) . Once stored and retrieved, such skills can repeatedly interfere with the agent’s behavior ( Dong et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) . Self-evolving agents therefore need to verify each skill’s reusability : whether the guidance remains useful when applied beyond the source experience.
paragraphs.zh: 自我进化的智能体通过从自身经验中学习来提升其能力（Gao 等，2026；Yang 等，2026）。 它们将任务解决经验提炼为技能（Anthropic，2025），这些技能提供流程性指导，并被存储在一个库中以便未来重复使用（Wang 等，2023；Ouyang 等，2026b）。 然而，提炼出的技能并不总能保证性能的提升（Li 等，2026；Han 等，2026；Gautam 等，2026）。 由于任务解决经验包含冗余的探索、错误和特定于任务的细节，提炼过程可能会产生错误的流程或无法迁移的知识（Ni 等，2026；Ma 等，2026；Xiong 等，2026）。 一旦存储和检索，这类技能可能会反复干扰智能体的行为（Dong 等，2026；Liang 等，2026）。 因此，自我进化的智能体需要验证每项技能的可重复使用性：即当这些指导被应用于源经验之外的场景时，是否仍然有效。

paragraphs.en: Such verification requires execution evidence from a scenario that is both skill-relevant and novel. That is, the agent should actually encounter the situation the skill addresses in a new environment, so that the evidence reveals whether the guidance improves its behavior beyond the source experience. Because different skills address different situations, the scenario that provides this evidence is inherently skill-specific. However, existing approaches ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2026a ) verify skills against a static pool of tasks that already exists, and merely select from it. Replaying the source task likely exposes the targeted situation, but only in the context the skill was distilled from, so the evidence is relevant but not novel ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Evaluating the skill on other existing tasks introduces new contexts, but since these tasks are defined independently of the skill, they need not expose the targeted situation.
paragraphs.zh: 此类验证需要来自一个既与技能相关又具有新颖性的场景的执行证据。 也就是说，智能体应当在新环境中实际遇到该技能所针对的情况，这样证据才能揭示指导是否使其行为超越了源经验。 由于不同技能针对不同的情况，提供这种证据的场景本质上就是特定于技能的。 然而，现有方法（Wang et al., 2025a；Zhang et al., 2026；Ouyang et al., 2026a）验证技能时，仅从已存在的静态任务池中挑选任务。 重演源任务很可能暴露出目标情况，但仅限于该技能被提炼出的原始情境，因此证据虽相关却缺乏新颖性（Chen et al., 2026a；Liu et al., 2026）。 在其他现有任务上评估该技能会引入新的情境，但由于这些任务是独立于技能定义的，它们未必能暴露出目标情况。

paragraphs.en: Verification should therefore shift from selecting existing tasks, to constructing the task and environment around the target skill, on demand. To this end, we propose SkillSandbox , a framework that dynamically synthesizes a task and environment where the target situation arises in a context different from the source experience to verify skills. Each synthesized task and its configured environment form a verification scenario, which serves as a controlled test of that skill. SkillSandbox consists of a Proposer , a Builder , and a Verifier , which design, construct, and evaluate this test, respectively. (i) The Proposer specifies the conditions that reproduce this situation and the modifications that distinguish the scenario from the source experience. (ii) The Builder realizes this specification as an executable task and its configured environment. (iii) The Verifier compares executions in the scenario with and without the skill and measures the effect of the skill in terms of executability, task success, and efficiency. Consequently, a reusable skill yields a positive effect across its scenarios and is admitted to the library, whereas a skill that is incorrect, overly specific, or not actionable yields no benefit or degrades execution and is rejected.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，验证的重心应从选择现有任务，转向按需构建围绕目标技能的任务和环境。 为此，我们提出了 SkillSandbox——一个动态合成任务与环境的框架，使目标情境在不同于源经验的上下文中出现，从而验证技能。 每个合成的任务及其配置的环境构成一个验证场景，该场景可作为对该技能的受控测试。 SkillSandbox 由提议者（Proposer）、构建者（Builder）和验证者（Verifier）组成，分别负责设计、构建和评估这一测试。 （i）提议者指定能够重现该情境的条件，以及使该场景与源经验区分开来的修改项。 （ii）构建者将该规格实现为可执行的任务及其配置的环境。 （iii）验证者比较在包含和不包含该技能的场景中的执行结果，并从可执行性、任务成功率和效率方面衡量该技能的效果。 因此，可重用的技能会在所有场景中产生积极效果并被纳入库中；而错误、过于具体或不可操作的技能则无法带来任何益处，甚至会降低执行效果，因而被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SkillSandbox on ALFWorld and WebShop by comparing the library of verified skills with libraries constructed by baseline methods, which either accumulate every generated skill or continually update the library as experience accumulates. Across three models, the verified library achieves the highest success rate with the fewest steps on both benchmarks. Further analyses show that the performance gains originate from the synthesized scenarios, as verification on source tasks or randomly selected tasks yields smaller gains and the gap widens on task types unseen in the source experience. In addition, the verification predicts the helpful and harmful effects of individual skills on held-out tasks. Each criterion also proves necessary, as the full Verifier outperforms variants that omit executability or efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过将已验证技能的库与基线方法构建的库进行比较，在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上对 SkillSandbox 进行了评估；这些基线方法要么积累所有生成的技能，要么随着经验积累而持续更新技能库。 在三种模型中，已验证的技能库在这两项基准测试中都实现了最高的成功率和最少的步骤数。 进一步的分析表明，性能提升源于合成的场景，因为对源任务或随机选择的任务进行验证所带来的提升较小，而在源经验中未出现过的任务类型上，这种差距会进一步扩大。 此外，该验证机制还能预测单个技能在预留测试任务中的有益和有害影响。 每个标准也被证明是必要的，因为完整的 Verifier 在性能上优于省略了可执行性或效率的变体版本。

paragraphs.en: We first ask whether the scenario synthesis is actually necessary to verify skills. Can existing tasks provide the evidence needed for verification? To answer this question, we examine alternatives to scenario synthesis and evaluate whether either one reliably provides the skill-specific evidence.

sents.en: Can existing tasks provide the evidence needed for verification?
sents.zh: 现有任务能否提供验证所需的证据？

sents.en: To answer this question, we examine alternatives to scenario synthesis and evaluate whether either one reliably provides the skill-specific evidence.
sents.zh: 为了回答这个问题，我们研究了场景合成的替代方案，并评估其中任何一种是否能可靠地提供与特定技能相关的证据。

paragraphs.en: Question I: Do semantically similar tasks expose the skill-relevant situation?
paragraphs.zh: 问题 I：语义相似的任务能否揭示与技能相关的情境？

paragraphs.en: Question II: How sparse are skill-relevant situations in downstream experience?
paragraphs.zh: 问题二：下游经验中，与技能相关的情境有多稀疏？

paragraphs.en: We examine whether semantic similarity can identify existing tasks that expose the skill-relevant situation. We use 50 skills per benchmark, 140 held-out tasks in ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) and nested pools of 200, 300, and 500 tasks in WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022a ) , keeping the same 50 skills across pool sizes. For each skill, we select the 10 held-out tasks whose instructions are most similar to the skill text. The agent executes each selected task with the target skill provided, and an LLM judge determines from the trajectory whether execution encounters the skill-relevant situation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们检验语义相似性是否能够识别出那些暴露与技能相关情境的现有任务。 每个基准测试中，我们使用 50 项技能，在 ALFWorld（Shridhar 等人，2020）中使用 140 个预留任务，并在 WebShop（Yao 等人，2022a）中使用包含 200、300 和 500 个任务的嵌套任务池，同时在整个不同规模的任务池中保持相同的 50 项技能。 对于每一项技能，我们选择其说明文本与技能文本最相似的 10 个预留任务。 智能体在执行每个选定的任务时都会使用所提供的目标技能，而一个 LLM 评判器则通过观察执行轨迹来判断是否遇到了与技能相关的情境。

paragraphs.en: Instruction similarity does not reliably identify tasks that exercise the target skill. As shown in Table 1 , the skill-relevant situation is observed in only up to 6.66 out of 10 selected tasks per skill across the settings. Even expanding the candidate pool from 200 to 500 tasks yields only marginal gains in skill-relevant coverage among the top-10 retrieved tasks. The main reason to this is that semantic similarity is measured at the task level, whereas skill relevance depends on what occurs during execution. Tasks with similar instructions can still induce different states, interactions, and intermediate decisions, and therefore need not expose the same skill-relevant situation. Consequently, task-level similarity does not reliably provide the execution evidence required for skill verification.
paragraphs.zh: 指令相似性无法可靠地识别出能够锻炼目标技能的任务。 如表 1 所示，在所有设置中，每个技能相关的任务中，最多仅有 6.66 个被选中的任务出现了与技能相关的情境。 即使将候选任务池从 200 个扩大到 500 个，在前 10 个检索到的任务中，与技能相关的覆盖范围也仅能获得微乎其微的提升。 造成这种情况的主要原因是，语义相似性是在任务层面进行测量的，而技能相关性则取决于执行过程中发生的情况。 指令相似的任务仍可能引发不同的状态、交互和中间决策，因此未必会暴露出相同的与技能相关的情境。 因此，任务层面的相似性无法可靠地提供技能验证所需的执行证据。

paragraphs.en: A second alternative is to accumulate verification evidence from subsequent downstream experience ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Xiong et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2026a ) . We construct a library of 50 skills and stream 500 held-out tasks in a fixed random order, repeating each setting three times. For each task, referenced skill IDs are recorded in rationale and counted. We vary the number of skills accessible, with Top-3 and Top-5 Retrieval providing the top-3 or 5 skills retrieved per task, respectively, and Full Library all 50 skills on every task. Figure 1 (a) reports the percentage of skills used in at least one task, and (b) reports the percentage used in at least 5 distinct tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种替代方案是从后续下游经验中积累验证证据（Zhang 等人，2026；Xiong 等人，2026；Ouyang 等人，2026a）。 我们构建了一个包含 50 项技能的库，并以固定的随机顺序流式处理 500 个预留任务，每种设置重复三次。 对于每个任务，引用的技能 ID 都会被记录在推理过程中并进行计数。 我们调整了可访问的技能数量：Top-3 和 Top-5 Retrieval 分别提供每个任务检索到的前 3 或 5 项技能，而 Full Library 则在每个任务中提供全部 50 项技能。 图 1(a) 报告了至少在一个任务中被使用的技能百分比，(b) 则报告了至少在 5 个不同任务中被使用的技能百分比。

sents.zh: 图 1(a) 报告了至少在一个任务中被使用的技能百分比，(b) 则报告了至少在 5 个不同任务中被使用的技能百分比。

paragraphs.en: Skill-relevant situations remain sparse as downstream experience accumulates. (a) shows that coverage grows slowly after 300 tasks. Executing 200 additional tasks raises the percentage of skills used at least once by only 4.7–6.7 percentage points. After 500 tasks, only 68% of skills are used under Top-3 Retrieval, 83% under Top-5, and 70% under Full Library. Thus, depending on the access setting, 17–32% of skills remain unexercised , which means that their effects on the agent’s behavior are never observed, leaving their reusability unverifiable. More reliable verification benefits from repeated evidence across distinct tasks, yet such opportunities are even more sparse. As shown in (b), only 44–55% of skills are used in at least 5 tasks. Even after 500 tasks, 45–56% of the skills fail to accumulate five execution opportunities. Overall, downstream experience leaves a substantial number of skills with insufficient evidence for verification.
paragraphs.zh: 随着下游经验的积累，与技能相关的情境仍然稀少。 (a) 显示，在完成 300 个任务后，覆盖度的增长变得缓慢。 执行额外 200 个任务，仅使至少使用过一次的技能比例上升了 4.7–6.7 个百分点。 完成 500 个任务后，在“Top-3 检索”设置下仅有 68% 的技能被使用，在“Top-5”下为 83%，而在“完整库”下为 70%。 因此，根据访问设置的不同，仍有 17–32% 的技能未被使用，这意味着它们对智能体行为的影响从未被观察到，其可重用性也因此无法验证。 更可靠的验证需要不同任务中重复出现的证据支持，但这样的机会甚至更加稀少。 如 (b) 所示，仅有 44–55% 的技能在至少 5 个任务中被使用过。 即使完成 500 个任务后，仍有 45–56% 的技能未能积累到五次执行机会。 总体而言，下游经验导致大量技能缺乏足够的证据以供验证。

paragraphs.en: Together, Questions I and II reveal complementary limitations of relying on existing tasks for verification. Neither reliably provides the skill-specific evidence that verification needs. We therefore construct verification scenarios that induce the target situation beyond its source experience.
paragraphs.zh: 问题 I 和问题 II 共同揭示了依赖现有任务进行验证所存在的互补性局限。 两者都无法可靠地提供验证所需的特定技能证据。 因此，我们构建验证场景，以在目标情境超出其源经验范围时诱发该情境。

sents.en: We verify the skill’s reusability along three dimensions:
sents.zh: 我们从三个维度验证该技能的可重用性：

paragraphs.en: Executability: The principle can be executed through admissible actions in the environment when the condition is satisfied.
paragraphs.zh: 可执行性：当条件满足时，该原则可以通过环境中允许的操作来执行。

paragraphs.en: Utility: Applying the principle helps the agent achieve the task goal, improving task success relative to execution without the skill.
paragraphs.zh: 效用：应用该原则有助于智能体实现任务目标，与不使用该技能执行任务相比，能提升任务成功率。

paragraphs.en: Efficiency: The principle enables the task completion with fewer actions than execution without the skill.
paragraphs.zh: 效率：该原则使得任务完成所需的动作次数少于不运用技能时的执行动作次数。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating these dimensions only on the source task x src x_{\mathrm{src}} does not establish reusability in new task contexts, while arbitrary tasks may not reproduce the situation described by the condition . Verification scenarios must therefore be both skill-relevant and novel . A scenario is skill-relevant when completing the task requires addressing the situation described by condition , in which the guidance in principle can be evaluated. It is novel when the agent encounters a task context that differs from the source experience.
paragraphs.zh: 仅在这些维度上基于源任务 x src x_{\mathrm{src}} 进行评估，并不能证明其在新任务情境中的可重用性，而任意任务可能无法重现该条件所描述的情形。 因此，验证场景必须既与技能相关，又具有新颖性。 当一个场景要求完成任务时必须处理条件所描述的情形时，该场景就是与技能相关的，此时原则上可以对该指导进行评估。 当智能体遇到一个与源经验不同的任务情境时，该场景就是新颖的。

sents.en: Verification scenarios must therefore be both skill-relevant and novel .
sents.zh: 因此，验证场景必须既与技能相关，又具有新颖性。

sents.en: A scenario is skill-relevant when completing the task requires addressing the situation described by condition , in which the guidance in principle can be evaluated.
sents.zh: 当一个场景要求完成任务时必须处理条件所描述的情形时，该场景就是与技能相关的，此时原则上可以对该指导进行评估。

sents.en: It is novel when the agent encounters a task context that differs from the source experience.
sents.zh: 当智能体遇到一个与源经验不同的任务情境时，该场景就是新颖的。

paragraphs.en: To construct scenarios that are both skill-relevant and novel, we reproduce the situation described by the condition while reconstructing the new task context. We jointly construct a task x δ x_{\delta} and configuration κ δ \kappa_{\delta} so that the condition holds during execution, while varying the details. Execution in the resulting scenario tests whether the principle remains useful when the situation described by the condition occurs in a context different from the source experience. Figure 2 illustrates this synthesis process. In SkillSandbox , the Proposer specifies how to reproduce the condition in a new context, and the Builder constructs the scenario according to this specification.
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建既与技能相关又具有新颖性的场景，我们在重构新任务上下文的同时，重现了该条件所描述的情形。 我们共同构建了一个任务 x δ x_{\delta} 和配置 κ δ \kappa_{\delta}，以便在执行过程中满足该条件，同时调整其细节。 在由此产生的场景中执行任务，可以检验当条件所描述的情形出现在与源经验不同的上下文中时，该原则是否仍然有效。 图 2 展示了这一合成过程。 在 SkillSandbox 中，提议者指定了如何在新的上下文中重现该条件，而构建者则根据这一规范来构建场景。

paragraphs.en: We first present the experimental setup (Section 4.1 ) and main results (Section 4.2 ). We compare SkillSandbox with baselines that construct skill libraries with or without verification. To examine how effectively each method retains reusable skills, we build a library using each method and evaluate it on the same held-out tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先介绍实验设置（第 4.1 节）和主要结果（第 4.2 节）。 我们将 SkillSandbox 与那些有或无验证地构建技能库的基线方法进行比较。 为了检验每种方法在保留可重用技能方面的有效性，我们使用每种方法构建一个技能库，并在相同的预留任务上对其进行评估。

sents.en: We first present the experimental setup (Section 4.1 ) and main results (Section 4.2 ).

sents.en: We compare SkillSandbox with baselines that construct skill libraries with or without verification.
sents.zh: 我们将 SkillSandbox 与那些有或无验证地构建技能库的基线方法进行比较。

sents.en: To examine how effectively each method retains reusable skills, we build a library using each method and evaluate it on the same held-out tasks.
sents.zh: 为了检验每种方法在保留可重用技能方面的有效性，我们使用每种方法构建一个技能库，并在相同的预留任务上对其进行评估。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) and WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022a ) . ALFWorld provides six household task types, and WebShop requires agents to find and purchase products that satisfy user instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ALFWorld（Shridhar 等人，2020）和 WebShop（Yao 等人，2022a）上进行评估。 ALFWorld 提供了六种家庭任务类型，而 WebShop 则要求智能体找到并购买满足用户指令的产品。

paragraphs.en: We report success rate (SR, %) on both benchmarks, average task score (Score, 0–100) on WebShop, and average steps across all episodes. To characterize how a skill library changes individual task outcomes beyond SR, we additionally report Recovery ( Rec. ) and Regression ( Reg. ) relative to the run without skill library of the same model. Recovery is the percentage of all held-out tasks that fail without skills but succeed with the library, whereas Regression is the percentage that succeed without skills but fail with the library.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个基准测试上报告成功率（SR，%），在 WebShop 上报告平均任务得分（Score，0–100），以及所有回合的平均步数。 为了描述技能库除了 SR 之外如何改变个体任务结果，我们还报告了相对于同一模型未使用技能库运行时的恢复率（Rec.）和退化率（Reg.）。 恢复率是指所有保留任务中，在没有技能时失败但使用技能库后成功的任务所占的百分比；而退化率则是指在没有技能时成功但使用技能库后失败的任务所占的百分比。

paragraphs.en: No Skill executes tasks without a skill library. Vanilla Skill retains all skills generated with the distillation prompt from SkillRL ( Xia et al., 2026 ) . We additionally compare with ReasoningBank ( Ouyang et al., 2026b ) and MemP ( Fang et al., 2026b ) , as well as execution-based library curation methods including ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , ACE ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and SkillOS ( Ouyang et al., 2026a ) . paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 4.1 , libraries admitted without our verification achieve lower SR than No Skill in most settings. This degradation is often accompanied by an increase in average steps, which means that the agent inefficiently spends more steps on redundant exploration yet solves fewer tasks. These results suggest that distilled skills can act as noise, impairing both task success and execution efficiency. Verifying their reusability before admission is therefore important for filtering out non-reusable skills.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 4.1 所示，未经我们验证而直接接纳的库在大多数设置中实现的 SR 低于“无技能”的情况。 这种性能下降通常伴随着平均步骤数的增加，这意味着智能体以低效的方式花费更多步骤进行冗余探索，但完成的任务却更少。 这些结果表明，蒸馏后的技能可能像噪声一样，同时损害任务成功率和执行效率。 因此，在接纳这些技能之前验证其可重用性，对于过滤掉不可重用的技能至关重要。

paragraphs.en: SkillSandbox consistently outperforms execution-based curation methods (ExpeL, ACE, and SkillOS) across all models and benchmarks, improving SR over the strongest of these baselines by up to 21.4%p. These results suggest that using execution feedback alone does not guarantee effective skill verification. ExpeL obtains evidence from repeated executions of the source task, whereas ACE and SkillOS use subsequent task stream. SkillSandbox instead acquires the verification evidence from execution on the skill-specific scenarios. Section 5.1 validates the contribution of scenario synthesis by comparing with other execution-based evidence under the same rollout budget.
paragraphs.zh: SkillSandbox 在所有模型和基准测试中均持续优于基于执行的筛选方法（ExpeL、ACE 和 SkillOS），其 SR 相较于这些基线方法中最强的一个提升了高达 21.4%p。 这些结果表明，仅使用执行反馈并不能保证技能验证的有效性。 ExpeL 通过重复执行源任务来获取证据，而 ACE 和 SkillOS 则利用后续的任务流。 相比之下，SkillSandbox 则是通过在特定技能场景下的执行来获取验证证据。 第 5.1 节通过将与其他基于执行的证据方法在相同展开预算下进行比较，验证了场景合成的贡献。

paragraphs.en: On ALFWorld with Gemini, MemP and SkillSandbox achieve the same Recovery , but SkillSandbox has approximately 37% lower Regression . Consequently, MemP reduces SR relative to No Skill, whereas SkillSandbox improves it. Reliable verification should therefore both help the agent solve previously failed tasks and preserve success on tasks it already solves.
paragraphs.zh: 在 ALFWorld 中，使用 Gemini、MemP 和 SkillSandbox 都能实现相同的恢复率，但 SkillSandbox 的退化率大约低 37%。 因此，与“无技能”模式相比，MemP 降低了成功恢复率（SR），而 SkillSandbox 则提高了该指标。 因此，可靠的验证既应帮助智能体解决之前失败的任务，也应确保其已能成功完成的任务不会出现问题。

paragraphs.en: Compared with the unverified Vanilla Skill library, verification increases Recovery by up to 9.2%p and reduces or maintains Regression across all settings. The resulting library achieves the lowest Regression across all settings and the highest Recovery in all but one setting. It is the only library with higher Recovery than Regression in every setting, consistently improving SR over No Skill. Together, these results show that verification selects an effective subset of the original library.
paragraphs.zh: 与未经验证的“基础技能”库相比，经过验证的库在所有设置中都将恢复率提升了最多 9.2%p，并降低了或维持了退化率。 由此生成的库在所有设置中实现了最低的退化率，并在除一种设置外的所有设置中实现了最高的恢复率。 这是唯一一个在所有设置中恢复率均高于退化率的库，并且始终比“无技能”设置能更好地提升 SR。 这些结果共同表明，验证过程能够从原始库中筛选出一个有效的子集。

paragraphs.en: On ALFWorld, Gemini and Qwen(27B) already solve most held-out tasks without skills, which leaves little room for verification to improve SR, yet SkillSandbox is the only library that does. On WebShop, where the executors solve far fewer tasks on their own, the verified library adds more than 10%p with lower Regression . Verification selects from the original library rather than improving the skills themselves, so it can add only what that library contains. Indeed, far fewer of the ALFWorld skills are helpful on held-out tasks (Section 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 ALFWorld 中，Gemini 和 Qwen(27B) 无需技能即可解决大多数预留任务，这使得通过验证来提升 SR 的空间很小，但 SkillSandbox 是唯一能做到这一点的库。 在 WebShop 中，执行器自行能解决的任务要少得多，而经过验证的库则带来了超过 10% 的性能提升，且回归率更低。 验证过程是从原始库中选择技能，而非改进技能本身，因此它只能添加该库中已有的内容。 事实上，在预留任务中，ALFWorld 的技能中有用的要少得多（第 5.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: The main experiments show that the verified library improves downstream performance. We now examine which components of our verification framework contribute to this improvement and whether it reflects accurate assessment of skill reusability through the following research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 主要实验表明，经过验证的库能够提升下游任务的性能。 接下来，我们将通过以下研究问题，考察我们验证框架中的哪些组件促成了这种性能提升，以及这种提升是否反映了技能可重用性的准确评估：

sents.en: We now examine which components of our verification framework contribute to this improvement and whether it reflects accurate assessment of skill reusability through the following research questions:
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将通过以下研究问题，考察我们验证框架中的哪些组件促成了这种性能提升，以及这种提升是否反映了技能可重用性的准确评估：

paragraphs.en: RQ1: Does scenario synthesis improve the effectiveness of verification?
paragraphs.zh: 问题1：场景合成能否提升验证的有效性？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: Does verification predict skill reusability?
paragraphs.zh: 问题2：验证能否预测技能的复用性？

paragraphs.en: RQ3: Does reliable skill verification require a stronger model?
paragraphs.zh: 问题3：可靠的技能验证是否需要更强大的模型？

paragraphs.en: RQ4: What do the synthesized scenarios reveal about skill reusability?
paragraphs.zh: 问题4：合成的场景揭示了技能可重用性的哪些信息？

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the contribution of synthesized scenarios, we compare verification evidence generated from synthesized scenarios, source tasks, and randomly selected tasks. We use Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite on both benchmarks and keep the Verifier and rollout budget fixed, varying only the tasks on which evidence is generated. Under this budget, each skill is verified on 5 synthesized scenarios, 5 executions of its source task, or 5 random tasks. We evaluate verification accuracy against each skill’s effectiveness on held-out tasks, measured through paired executions with and without the skill (Appendix B ). A skill is labeled helpful if it increases the success rate and harmful if it decreases.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估合成场景的贡献，我们将通过合成场景、源任务和随机选定的任务生成的验证证据进行比较。 我们在两个基准测试中都使用 Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite，并保持验证器和展开预算不变，仅改变生成证据的任务。 在此预算下，每个技能会在 5 个合成场景、其源任务的 5 次执行或 5 个随机任务上进行验证。 我们将验证准确性与每个技能在预留任务上的有效性进行比较，通过有技能和无技能的配对执行进行测量（附录 B）。 如果某个技能提高了成功率，则被标记为“有帮助”；如果降低了成功率，则被标记为“有害”。

paragraphs.en: Synthesized scenarios yield the highest verdict F1 and the best-performing skill library on both benchmarks (Figure 3 ), with held-out SR up to 15.7%p above the alternatives. On ALFWorld, the verdicts from source and random tasks barely separate helpful from harmful skills, and the libraries they retain fall below No Skill, with random-task verification even below the unverified library. Source tasks expose the skill-relevant situation only in its original context and random tasks rarely expose it at all, so neither provides the evidence that verification requires.
paragraphs.zh: 合成的场景在两项基准测试中均获得了最高的裁决 F1 值和表现最佳的技能库（图 3），其保留的 SR 比替代方案高出最多 15.7%p。 在 ALFWorld 中，来自源任务和随机任务的裁决几乎无法区分有益技能和有害技能，且它们保留的技能库表现甚至低于“无技能”组，而随机任务验证的表现还低于未验证的技能库。 源任务仅在原始上下文中暴露与技能相关的情境，而随机任务则几乎完全不暴露该情境，因此两者都无法提供验证所需的证据。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 reports precision, recall, F1, and specificity of the verdicts on both benchmarks. On WebShop, verification closely predicts the held-out utility of retained skills. High precision and specificity indicate that verification reliably retains helpful skills on held-out tasks while filtering out harmful ones. The 82.8% recall shows that verification preserves most helpful skills, although some are incorrectly rejected. Thus, on WebShop, a Keep verdict provides a strong indication that the skill remians useful beyond its source experience.
paragraphs.zh: 表3报告了两种基准测试中判定结果的精确率、召回率、F1值和特异性。 在WebShop上，验证结果能准确预测保留技能在预留测试集上的效用。 高精确率和特异性表明，验证过程能够可靠地保留预留任务中的有用技能，同时过滤掉有害技能。 82.8%的召回率显示，验证过程保留了大部分有用技能，尽管其中一些技能被错误地拒绝了。 因此，在WebShop上，“保留”判定强烈表明该技能在其来源经验之外仍然具有实用价值。

paragraphs.en: Overall agreement is lower on ALFWorld, but verification still preserves the useful skills and improves the composition of the library. Only 23.9% of the ALFWorld skills are helpful on held-out tasks, which lowers precision. Verification nevertheless retains 81.8% of the helpful skills, nearly the same recall as on WebShop, and helpful skills make up 39.1% of the verified library, which is higher than the unverified library. paragraphs.en: On WebShop, agents take more actions on average with skills, even when both with and without-skill runs succeed. For Qwen3.5-27B and Gemini, skills improve task success but also add inefficiency on tasks that succeed without them. This indicates that since success gains alone are insufficient to assess skill reusability, verification must also account for the additional actions introduced by skill guidance. On ALFWorld, both Qwen models instead gain in success and save actions, showing that skill guidance can also yield successful execution. Gemini exhibits a different failure pattern. Despite high executability, skill lowers success and increases action counts, exposing a limitation in the benefit of the guidance beyond whether it can be followed.
paragraphs.zh: 在 WebShop 中，即使有技能和无技能的运行都成功了，使用技能的智能体平均执行的动作仍然更多。 对于 Qwen3.5-27B 和 Gemini，技能虽然提高了任务成功率，但在原本无需技能即可成功的任务中也会增加低效操作。 这表明，仅凭成功次数的提升不足以评估技能的可重复使用性，验证时还必须考虑技能引导所引入的额外动作。 在 ALFWorld 中，两款 Qwen 模型的成功率反而有所提升，同时减少了动作数量，这说明技能引导也能实现成功执行。 Gemini 表现出不同的失败模式。 尽管可执行性很高，但技能却降低了成功率并增加了动作数量，暴露出这种引导的价值不仅取决于能否被遵循，还存在其他局限性。

paragraphs.en: Agents acquire reusable skills by abstracting past executions into programs or workflows that can be retrieved and applied in subsequent tasks ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . A complementary approach distills successful and failed experiences into textual insights, reasoning strategies, or procedural instructions that guide future decisions ( Zhao et al., 2024 ; Ouyang et al., 2026b ; Fang et al., 2026b ) . Feedback-driven curation provides an implicit form of verification, using subsequent execution outcomes to revise stored guidance or learn policies for managing the skill repository ( Fang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2026a ) . More explicit verification evaluates the effects of individual skills through source-task tests or paired runs with and without the skill, informing refinement and retention decisions ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . However, these methods can leave skills insufficiently verified, as the verification evidence they provide are neither skill-relevant nor new. We identify the lack of reliable opportunities to evaluate each skill as a central verification problem.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体通过将过往的执行过程抽象为可检索并在后续任务中应用的程序或工作流，从而获得可重复使用的技能（Wang et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2025b；Wang et al., 2025a）。 一种互补的方法则是将成功与失败的经验提炼为文本形式的见解、推理策略或程序性指令，以指导未来的决策（Zhao et al., 2024；Ouyang et al., 2026b；Fang et al., 2026b）。 反馈驱动的整理提供了一种隐式的验证形式：利用后续执行的结果来修订已存储的指导信息，或学习管理技能库的策略（Fang et al., 2026b；Zhang et al., 2026；Ouyang et al., 2026a）。 更明确的验证方法则通过源任务测试或对比运行（分别使用和不使用该技能）来评估单个技能的效果，从而为技能的优化与保留决策提供依据（Wang et al., 2025a；Ma et al., 2026）。 然而，这些方法可能导致技能验证不足，因为它们提供的验证证据既与技能本身无关，也缺乏新颖性。 我们认为，缺乏可靠的技能评估机会是验证问题的核心所在。

paragraphs.en: Recent approaches synthesize tasks and environments to train LLM agents. Task generation expands training opportunities within available environments ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Qi et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Environment synthesis constructs the interaction setting itself through executable environments or LLM-based simulators ( Chae et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026a ; Song et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . Adaptive approaches use the learner’s performance to guide generation toward suitable difficulty levels or weaknesses in the current policy ( Dennis et al., 2020 ; Zala et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) . However, these objectives are insufficient for skill verification on their own, as they do not ensure that execution encounters the situation that the skill targets. To address the challenges in skill verification, we propose a framework that dynamically synthesizes tasks and environment for each target skill at verification time.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的方法通过合成任务和环境来训练大型语言模型智能体。 任务生成扩展了在可用环境中的训练机会（Zhou 等人，2025；Sun 等人，2025；Qi 等人，2025；Zhou 等人，2026）。 环境合成通过可执行环境或基于大型语言模型的模拟器构建交互设置本身（Chae 等人，2026；Fang 等人，2026a；Song 等人，2026；Chen 等人，2026b）。 自适应方法利用学习者的表现来引导生成适合当前策略难度水平或薄弱环节的任务（Dennis 等人，2020；Zala 等人，2024；Guo 等人，2025）。 然而，这些目标本身不足以验证技能，因为它们无法确保执行过程会遇到该技能所针对的情况。 为了解决技能验证中的挑战，我们提出了一种框架，在验证时针对每个目标技能动态合成任务和环境。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SkillSandbox , a framework that verifies skill reusability by dynamically synthesizing tasks and environments that reproduce each skill’s applicable conditions in contexts beyond its source experience. The framework verifies each skill by having the agent solve the synthesized tasks in the synthesized environments, testing whether its guidance remains useful in these new situations. Across ALFWorld and WebShop, the verified libraries achieve the highest success rate and efficiency compared to other methods. Further analyses show that synthesized scenarios improve the quality of verification, and that effective verification is possible using the executor’s own model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SkillSandbox，一个通过动态合成任务与环境来验证技能可复用性的框架。这些任务与环境能够再现每项技能在其源经验之外的适用条件。 该框架通过让智能体在合成的环境中解决合成的任务来验证每一项技能，从而测试其指导是否在这些新情境中仍然有效。 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 中，经过验证的技能库与其他方法相比实现了最高的成功率和效率。 进一步的分析表明，合成的场景提升了验证的质量，并且使用执行器自身的模型也能实现有效的验证。

paragraphs.en: We distinguish no verification (unconditionally retaining generated skills) from execution-based verification , which includes feedback-driven skill admission, revision, removal, or reweighting. The latter uses either source replay (repeated attempts at the original task) or downstream tasks (subsequent source tasks selected independently of a skill). All libraries are built from the same 100 source tasks and frozen before held-out evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将无验证（无条件保留生成的技能）与基于执行的验证区分开来，后者包括反馈驱动的技能接纳、修订、移除或重新加权。 后者使用源任务重演（对原始任务的重复尝试）或下游任务（后续独立于某项技能选择的源任务）。 所有库均基于相同的 100 个源任务构建，并在预留的评估之前被冻结。

paragraphs.en: No verification. ReasoningBank sequentially solves source tasks using prior memories, judges each outcome, and extracts up to three structured memories from each trajectory. paragraphs.en: Execution-based verification: source replay. ExpeL collects source trajectories before extracting insights. After failure, our executor reflects and retries the same task at most once. paragraphs.en: Execution-based verification: downstream tasks. ACE solves tasks with an evolving playbook, reflects on entry helpfulness, and incrementally curates the playbook. Our implementation makes three source passes, adding entries and updating feedback counters, with separate duplicate merging and budget-triggered pruning of harmful entries. Held-out evaluation uses the entire frozen playbook rather than top-three retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 基于执行的验证：下游任务。 ACE 通过不断演化的策略集来完成任务，会反思条目是否有用，并逐步优化该策略集。 我们的实现会进行三次源数据遍历，添加条目并更新反馈计数器，同时分别处理重复条目的合并以及因预算触发而对有害条目的剪枝。 预留的评估过程使用整个冻结的策略集，而非仅检索排名前三的条目。

paragraphs.en: Execution-based verification: downstream tasks. We use training-free SkillOS-base ( Ouyang et al., 2026a ) , with the paper’s Appendix A prompts. The executor makes one ordered source pass, retrieving skills from the evolving repository with BM25. After each task, the curator uses its trajectory, outcome, and retrieved skills to insert, update, or delete skills before the next task.

paragraphs.en: The synthesis typology of Section 5.4 covers scenarios generated for WebShop and ALFWorld skills in the Qwen3.5-27B setting. For each environment, GPT-5.6 Luna first summarizes each scenario’s operations and implementation plan in one or two sentences and induces types from these summaries. To categorize how skills cause harm, we select the scenarios, in which the executor fails with the skill, succeeds without it, and receives a negative scenario score. Given the skill, both trajectories, and their outcomes, the same model explains how the skill could have contributed to the failure, and the explanations are grouped into types in the same way.
